title: Support participants
description: Help someone get to Middle-earth. If you can and want to, you can contribute to the registration fee for a participant who would otherwise miss out.
subtitle: Help someone get to Middle-earth.
intro_p1: Some participants want to come, but the registration fee may be a barrier. If you can and want to support someone, you can contribute to another player’s registration fee.
intro_p2_mid: if you know who you want to help, or
intro_p2_post: — in that case we use it for participants who reach out to us asking for help.
intro_p3: We always try to be sensitive. We do not publish participants’ personal situations and arrangements are handled individually.
opt_specific_desc: I know who I want to help. A specific friend, a younger participant, someone from my group or community.
opt_general_desc: I want to contribute to the participation of someone who couldn’t otherwise come. You decide who the help reaches.
opt_other_title: Help in other ways than financial
opt_other_desc: I can offer a lift, sharing of gear, costume, tent, facilities, mentoring for a newcomer — or another form that makes sense. We agree on it case by case.
how_2: Tell us whether you want to support a specific participant, generally, or offer non-financial help.
how_3: We agree on the specific amount, form and way of handover.
how_4: After handover we confirm to you that the support reached the participant (with respect to their privacy).
alert: We treat support as a commitment. If you contact us, we will get back to you as soon as possible and arrange the details. We don’t bind anyone to public disclosure or thanks unless they want it.
rel_1_label: When the registration fee is a problem
rel_3_post: — Moravian LARP, z. s. and contacts.
rel_4_post: — when you want to help or ask.
cta_body: Write us. Even a smaller contribution may mean someone can come. Middle-earth remembers those who added a log to the fire.
